_comment: APK-shell update manifest. The app auto-updates its web content from the live URL; this only triggers the in-app 'download new APK' banner when apk.build here is GREATER than the versionCode installed on the device. To release a NEW APK: bump android/app/build.gradle versionCode, build, upload to Drive, then set apk.build to that number + apk.url to the new Drive share link + notes, and push.
